summary:
AgroVision is a web-based agricultural analytics platform designed to help farmers better understand their land through historical environmental data and visual analysis.

Our prototype focuses on comparing land conditions across different years and providing detailed weather analytics, including temperature trends and extreme temperature records over a one-year period. These insights help farmers observe environmental changes and better understand the climate conditions affecting their fields.

AgroVision aims to make complex Earth observation information accessible through clear visualizations and an easy-to-use interface.

In alignment with NASA's Field Shift challenge, our long-term vision is to combine NASA Earth observation data with local soil information, crop characteristics, and farmer priorities to support climate-aware crop planning and the comparison of sustainable crop rotation strategies.

By transforming environmental data into understandable information, AgroVision seeks to support more resilient and informed agricultural decisions.
